ROBERT PARKER.name: Robert Parker
ROBERT PARKER.background: Long County District 5 commissioner and former commission chairman. ROBERT PARKER.record: Was arrested in late February 2025 in GBI and FBI raids and charged with violating Georgia's racketeering act, three counts of theft by taking, violation of oath of office, and aggravated assault. The commission discussed removing him in May 2025 but did not. Gov. Brian Kemp accepted his resignation in early August 2025, and the vacancy went to the Nov. 4, 2025 special election. WTOC's August 2025 report did not mention a plea, trial date or outcome.
ROBERT PARKER.notes: Listed as Robert D. Parker in the Tattnall Journal. The Coastal Courier arrest story says the case file was to go to the Attorney General's Office once the investigation was complete. No source opened in this run reports an indictment, plea or verdict. Neither source gives the years of his chairmanship or when he first joined the commission.
